subject: Urgent: throughput & p95 spike after v3.1-quant rollout (requires exec attention)
messages:
From: Evan Park <evan.park@nimbuslogistics.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: ops@nimbuslogistics.com
Date: 2027-10-09T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Production impact after v3.1-quant rollout

Hi Aisha —

We pushed the v3.1-quant profile to production late last night (your team’s rollout). Starting ~01:30 PDT we see a sharp drop in sustained throughput (~30%) and p95 latency jump from 120ms to ~640ms across our hot routes. Error rate (5xx) has risen to ~4% for requests with sequence length >512. The spike coincides exactly with the rollout window.

Attaching a small perf dump and the SLO graph. Key notes:
- Host group: nimbus-hot-03c
- Typical qps pre-rollout: 420 -> post: 290
- Error sample: 503 downstream decode-failure (4xx->5xx chain)

We need an immediate mitigation plan and an estimated timeline for rollback. Our checkout peak is in ~3 hours; if this persists we will hit internal SLAs.

Attached: perf-dump-20271008.csv, slo-p95-graph-20271009.png

— Evan
Evan Park
Head of Platform Engineering, Nimbus Logistics
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Evan Park <evan.park@nimbuslogistics.com>, ops@nimbuslogistics.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-09T15:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production impact after v3.1-quant rollout

Thanks Evan — and sorry for the disruption. I’ve looped in Karthik and Irene from SRE/serving and Marissa for exec coordination.

Immediate plan:
- Karthik: triage and confirm whether issue is kernel selection / batch scheduling interaction with the new qprofile.
- If root cause not obvious within 45 minutes we will initiate a controlled rollback to v3.0 on Nimbus traffic only (canary -> full).
- Please share any additional traces (x-request-id) and two representative request payloads for the failed 503s.

I’ll schedule a 30-min emergency call now and propose an exec sync tomorrow 8:30am PT if needed.

Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Success, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com, Evan Park <evan.park@nimbuslogistics.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-09T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production impact after v3.1-quant rollout

Quick triage notes (summary):
- Initial perf traces point to increased decode time tied to the new INT8 kernel choices for sequences >512.
- KV cache hit ratios unchanged, so not a prefix/cache regression.
- Batch formation latency increased at the worker-level under the new qprofile; that lines up with throughput drop + p95 shift.

Mitigation options:
1) Immediate: rollback Nimbus traffic to v3.0 (safe path, ~12–18m for canary->full if we automate).
2) Short-term: pin qprofile to v3.1-default (non-quant) for high-seq routes — ~20m to flip route-level policy.
3) Longer: kernel patch (requires infra release) — ETA 5d.

I recommend option 1 as the fastest and lowest-risk. I’ll prepare a rollback runbook now and push the draft to the drive link. If we get authorization, I can start the canary in ~10m.

Attachments: mitigation-draft-v1.md (runbook stub)

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

Thanks Karthik — option 1 sounds reasonable. Please confirm the rollback steps and expected timeline; we need an SLA-safe window. Also Bethany (CPO) asked for an exec update; she’d like an all-hands with Redwood leadership tomorrow morning PT to understand impact and compensation (credits/discount).

We’ll provide the x-request-ids as you request. If a rollback can be completed before our 19:00 checkout peak that would be ideal.

— Evan
